description: Opaque deep-red floor-length fitted court gown with low square neckline, structured bodice, narrow decorated waist belt and elbow-length red sleeves with gold woven/embroidered border at their hems. Both sleeves end around the elbows, above exposed forearms. Rich gold floral and geometric borders line neckline, center panel and skirt hem; small round brooches at the upper bodice, restrained pendant necklace. Ivory patterned underdress panel and cream-gold wrap loosely draped along forearms, separate from red sleeves; brown shoes visible below the skirt. No headgear, armor, weapon or banner; plain stone doorway with climbing ivy at one side.
